mapper.select: WITH PROJECT_STATS AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS PARTICIPATING_PROJECT_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN PM.ROLE = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 END ) AS MANAGED_PROJECT_COUNT FROM PROJECT_MEMBER PM INNER JOIN PROJECT P ON P.PROJECT_ID = PM.PROJECT_ID WHERE PM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), ISSUE_STATS AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS ASSIGNED_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'TODO' THEN 1 END ) AS TODO_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 END ) AS IN_PROGRESS_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 END ) AS DONE_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND I.PRIORITY = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END ) AS HIGH_PRIORITY_OPEN_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND I.PRIORITY = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END ) AS MEDIUM_PRIORITY_OPEN_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS IN ('TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND I.PRIORITY = 'LOW' THEN 1 END ) AS LOW_PRIORITY_OPEN_ISSUE_COUNT FROM ISSUE I INNER JOIN PROJECT P ON P.PROJECT_ID = I.PROJECT_ID INNER JOIN PROJECT_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJECT_ID = I.PROJECT_ID AND PM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE I.ASSIGNEE_ID = #{memberId} AND I.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL ) SELECT PROJECT_STATS.PARTICIPATING_PROJECT_COUNT, PROJECT_STATS.MANAGED_PROJECT_COUNT, ISSUE_STATS.ASSIGNED_ISSUE_COUNT, ISSUE_STATS.TODO_ISSUE_COUNT, ISSUE_STATS.IN_PROGRESS_ISSUE_COUNT, ISSUE_STATS.DONE_ISSUE_COUNT, ISSUE_STATS.HIGH_PRIORITY_OPEN_ISSUE_COUNT, ISSUE_STATS.MEDIUM_PRIORITY_OPEN_ISSUE_COUNT, ISSUE_STATS.LOW_PRIORITY_OPEN_ISSUE_COUNT FROM PROJECT_STATS CROSS JOIN ISSUE_STATS

WITH MANAGED_PROJECTS AS ( SELECT P.PROJECT_ID FROM PROJECT P INNER JOIN PROJECT_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJECT_ID = P.PROJECT_ID WHERE PM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PM.ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL ) SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT MANAGED_PROJECTS.PROJECT_ID ) AS MANAGED_PROJECT_COUNT, COUNT( I.ISSUE_ID ) AS TOTAL_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS IN ( 'TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS' ) THEN 1 END ) AS OPEN_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 END ) AS DONE_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.ISSUE_ID IS NOT NULL AND I.ASSIGNEE_ID IS NULL THEN 1 END ) AS UNASSIGNED_ISSUE_COUNT FROM MANAGED_PROJECTS LEFT JOIN ISSUE I ON I.PROJECT_ID = MANAGED_PROJECTS.PROJECT_ID AND I.DELETED_AT IS NULL

WITH MANAGED_PROJECTS AS ( SELECT P.PROJECT_ID, P.NAME AS PROJECT_NAME FROM PROJECT P INNER JOIN PROJECT_MEMBER ADMIN_PM ON ADMIN_PM.PROJECT_ID = P.PROJECT_ID WHERE ADMIN_PM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ADMIN_PM.ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), MEMBER_STATS AS ( SELECT PM.PROJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM PROJECT_MEMBER PM INNER JOIN MANAGED_PROJECTS MP ON MP.PROJECT_ID = PM.PROJECT_ID GROUP BY PM.PROJECT_ID ), ISSUE_STATS AS ( SELECT I.PROJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'TODO' THEN 1 END ) AS TODO_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 END ) AS IN_PROGRESS_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 END ) AS DONE_ISSUE_COUNT, COUNT( CASE WHEN I.ASSIGNEE_ID IS NULL THEN 1 END ) AS UNASSIGNED_ISSUE_COUNT FROM ISSUE I INNER JOIN MANAGED_PROJECTS MP ON MP.PROJECT_ID = I.PROJECT_ID WHERE I.DELETED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY I.PROJECT_ID ) SELECT MP.PROJECT_ID, MP.PROJECT_NAME, NVL( MS.MEMBER_COUNT, 0 ) AS MEMBER_COUNT, NVL( IST.TOTAL_ISSUE_COUNT, 0 ) AS TOTAL_ISSUE_COUNT, NVL( IST.TODO_ISSUE_COUNT, 0 ) AS TODO_ISSUE_COUNT, NVL( IST.IN_PROGRESS_ISSUE_COUNT, 0 ) AS IN_PROGRESS_ISSUE_COUNT, NVL( IST.DONE_ISSUE_COUNT, 0 ) AS DONE_ISSUE_COUNT, NVL( IST.UNASSIGNED_ISSUE_COUNT, 0 ) AS UNASSIGNED_ISSUE_COUNT FROM MANAGED_PROJECTS MP LEFT JOIN MEMBER_STATS MS ON MS.PROJECT_ID = MP.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN ISSUE_STATS IST ON IST.PROJECT_ID = MP.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY MP.PROJECT_ID DESC
